findings.basis: Key read, no candidate value. Google CarrierSettings still carries the key for about 240 kodiak textprotos; it is a real but obsolete carrier setting.
findings.effect: The key has no reader on LineageOS 23.2. CarrierConfigManager documents it as deprecated ('The allow alerts option is always shown now', CarrierConfigManager.java:1201-1210; @Deprecated in core/api/current.txt:45559), with default false (11967). Its only historical reader, CellBroadcastReceiver's settings screen (added in 775699f27, 2015), was removed on 2020-01-09 in commits 6d6451d1e/b612d59ea; neither CellBroadcastReceiver nor CellBroadcastService in the tree mentions it now. Visibility of the 'Allow alerts' main switch is driven by the CellBroadcastReceiver resource show_main_switch_settings (CellBroadcastSettings.java:648-656, res/values/config.xml:23), and whether alerts reach the person is decided by the user's master-toggle preference with the resource default master_toggle_enabled_default (CellBroadcastAlertService.java:574-586, CellBroadcastConfigService.java:187,734) plus always-on channel ranges; none of these read carrier config for this key. Even when the key was read, it only made the switch visible; it never turned alerts off. On the phone (LineageOS 24.0), the cell broadcast module APK (apex com.android.cellbroadcast) and CellBroadcastLegacyApp were checked: their dex contains enable_alerts_master_toggle but not always_show_emergency_alert_onoff, so the 24.0 build has no reader either.
findings.risk: None for emergency, TTY, RTT or priority calls or emergency SMS: the key reaches no code. It cannot hide or show the alert switch on this ROM and cannot stop wireless emergency alerts from reaching the person.

notes: Proceed: the key leaves group A. It is deprecated and unread on LineageOS 23.2 (removed from CellBroadcastReceiver in January 2020) and absent from the 24.0 phone's cell broadcast module; when it was read it only controlled whether a settings switch was shown. Whether alerts are delivered is decided by the user's main switch and resource defaults, not by this key.
